Large thermal gradients cause warping; heated enclosure and emission control matter.

summary.text: ABS-ESD is electrostatic-dissipative acrylonitrile butadiene styrene. Makers sell it for prototypes, end-use parts and protecting electronics, and a maker advises against insulating paints, which would spoil its ESD properties. Its HDT at 0.45 MPa is 97 °C. On the H2C it prints at 260⁠–⁠265 °C, but most products call for drying, and a maker says it absorbs moisture easily.

items.text: Ideal for prototyping or end-use parts among both industry engineers and hobbyists alike
3DXSTAT ESD ABS is an advanced ESD-Safe compound designed for use in critical applications which require electrostatic discharge (ESD) protection and a high level of cleanliness.
Durable and sturdy parts off practically every machine on the market
Higher melting point and thermal properties than PLA or PETG

Manufactured with consistency in mind, 3DXTECH starts with premium ABS and then compounds it according to a proprietary formulation of multi-wall carbon nanotubes – giving you a filament with excellent printing characteristics and consistent ESD properties.
Easier to print than most industrial-grade materials
Thanks to the material's excellent printability and static dissipation properties, ESD-ABS is suitable for general manufacturing and electronic industries.

Thanks to this advanced production process, the residual amounts of solvents and monomers used in the production process in the final ABS product are extremely low, so the consumables are printed The process has low odor.

items.text: It is an ideal filament for applications in automotive, aerospace, semiconductor industry, electronic and electrical industries.
ESD ABS, like ABS, has good heat resistance, high tenacity and impact resistance, and good antistatic performance as well.
As the ESD ABS filament absorbs moisture easily, it should be dried before being used.
Recommended Support Material Self-supporting, HIPS
The filament is ideal for industrial applications like housings / casings for connectors, sensors and measuring devices.
ABS ESD Filament has been designed for protection of electronic devices which are sensitive to electrostatic discharges.
The material prevents the risk of damage to vulnerable electronic components due to its dissipative properties.
Electrostatic Discharge Protection.
High Impact Resistance.
Low dust / powder attraction.
Drying Recommendations: 80°C, 2-4 hours
it is suitable for areas that req uire electrostatic protection for precision electronic components, integrated circuits and their packages.
ABS-ESD is an antistatic modified material with excellent permanent antistatic effect, surface resistivity of 109Ω, easy to print and smooth surface.
Low warpage
Smooth Print Surface
